name: Deadlocke
source: After experiencing the monotonous day-to-day of being an errand runner, the first exciting thing happened in her life since forever plunged Red into going on the run with a reclusive hacker, Wolf. Although, whether if she can trust him or not, is another story entirely.
translation: 瑞德一直过着替人跑腿、日复一日单调无聊的生活。许久以来头一回遇上的刺激事件，却迫使她与深居简出的黑客沃尔夫一同踏上逃亡之路。至于她能否相信他，那又是另一回事了。
